args.title: Prevent auto-dismissal and use assertive aria-live for error toasts
args.body:
File: src/components/Toast.tsx

Update the Toast component to handle error toasts separately: error toasts should use role="alert" and aria-live="assertive" and should not auto-dismiss after 5000ms, remaining on screen until explicitly dismissed by the user.

This comment was written by RepoMind, an automated triage agent. To reach a person, mention @ledgerline/maintainers.

Error toasts currently use polite announcements and auto-dismiss after 5000ms, whereas they should be assertive and persistent until dismissed.
